result.summary: Found a few visual/layout issues, mostly related to horizontally clipped content and content being obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The page content is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar. The second restaurant card image is cut off by the tab bar, making the screen feel unfinished and potentially hiding tappable content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area spacing to the scroll content equal to the bottom navigation height so cards can scroll fully above the nav.

issues.description: The category chip row shows a partially visible blank/grey pill at the far right edge after “Healthy,” which looks like a broken or empty filter.
issues.suggestion: Adjust horizontal scroll spacing or chip sizing so the next chip is either meaningfully visible with text or not visible at all.

issues.description: The “Fastest near you” carousel cuts off the third restaurant card and title at the right edge, making the restaurant name appear truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer carousel peek style, reduce card width/gap, or apply intentional text truncation with ellipsis within the visible card area.
